column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the pycodemod warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Core: `--` Ends the Flags, an Unread File Reported Beside What Was Found, and UNKNOWN Never a Guess
The Commentary: A Mark Bounded Only Where It Is a Word, a Paragraph as One Incident, and a Gate With One Matcher on Both Sides
The Exit Censuses: SystemExit Is Not an Exception, the Guard Is Its Body Alone, and Every Skip Returned Rather Than Accumulated
The Ambient Census: A Property Not a Name, getcwd Actually in the Vocabulary, and Subtrees Read From the Tree Alone
The Sites Walk: A Result That Carries Its Query, Facts Keyed by Span, and No Call Doubling as a Reference
The Argument Readings: Every Side of Every Split, a Splat That Cannot Tell, and No Scan Read Beyond Its Query
The Dead Census: Every Exemption Named, a Dispatch Is a String in Code, and No Verdict Over a Narrowed Scan
The Module Consumers: A Dotted Module Found, the Name an Import Truly Binds, and No Unread File Read as Empty
